items.title: 67425_Tiny Grimes oral history interview
items.q: we had John Letterman, trumpet and a drummer over there... Wallace Bishop... How did you like playing with organ players.

ctx.x: Yeah, we had John Letterman, trumpet and a drummer over there...
...He never did progress, as you might say. Boy, he played like he was playin' in 1930. I shouldn't say that...
